description: Golden-image fixtures for the WUI detector evaluation (wuiDetector.eval.test.ts). `expect` lists detector classes a human verified as clearly visible — image-level ground truth, not exhaustive box labels. Images are drawn from the license-policed training-data/harvest pool (CC0/PD/CC BY, attribution below) plus JANUS's own Boise field photos.
